meta.move: Long messages with curly quotes and a concession
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went into the gradebook?

I want to be fair to Owen. I compared the essay with his in-class writing from September 24: 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices throughout, no quotations. This essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line, and none of those errors.
A forty-minute timed piece against an essay he wrote over a weekend. Show me both, with the dates on them. And you still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen before that zero went in.
You’re right that the checker alone proves nothing. I’m taking it off the table. I’m relying on the writing and the version history.

Then I'm writing down that the checker is off the table. Version history of what, from when, and I want it in front of me, not described. And for the third time, Hale: was Owen heard before you entered the zero?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
To: Hale
Cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

In today's meeting you agreed that the AI checker result proves nothing on its own and that you are taking it off the table. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology, copies of the September 24 in-class writing and the version history you referred to, and a direct answer as to whether Owen was heard before the zero was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position; she agreed to nothing, though she noted your concession on the checker.
What moved her: nothing; the dated September 24 in-class writing comparison came closest, but she wanted to see it, and she said three times that you hadn't answered whether Owen was heard first.
